description: This header file declares internal function prototypes for managing a system recycle bin component within the BroadWay Runtime System environment. It includes functions for accessing and modifying the recycle bin's folders, records, and properties.

methods.name: SysRboGetServedFolder
methods.description: Retrieves the folder currently served by the Recycle Bin object.

methods.name: SysRboSetServedFolder
methods.description: Sets the folder to be served by the Recycle Bin object.

methods.name: SysRboGetUserContext
methods.description: Retrieves the user-specific context associated with the Recycle Bin.

methods.name: SysRboSetUserContext
methods.description: Sets the user-specific context for the Recycle Bin.

methods.name: SysRboGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the Recycle Bin object.

methods.name: SysRboSetProperty
methods.description: Sets properties of the Recycle Bin object.

methods.name: SysRboResetProperty
methods.description: Resets the properties of the Recycle Bin to default values.

methods.name: SysRboReset
methods.description: Resets the entire Recycle Bin object state.

methods.name: SysRboDelAllFolders
methods.description: Deletes all folders within the Recycle Bin.

methods.name: SysRboDelAllRecords
methods.description: Deletes all records within the Recycle Bin.

methods.name: SysRboGetFolderCount
methods.description: Returns the number of folders in the Recycle Bin.

methods.name: SysRboGetRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the number of records in the Recycle Bin.

methods.name: SysRboAddFolder
methods.description: Adds a new folder to the Recycle Bin.

methods.name: SysRboGetFolderByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a folder by its index.

methods.name: SysRboAddRecord
methods.description: Adds a new record to the Recycle Bin.

methods.name: SysRboGetRecordByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a record by its index.
